description: This file contains functions for managing Discord channels via API calls, including creating, editing, deleting, moving, and setting permissions for channels.

methods.name: createChannelDiscord
methods.description: Creates a new Discord channel with specified parameters.

methods.name: editChannelDiscord
methods.description: Edits an existing Discord channel with provided updates.

methods.name: moveChannelDiscord
methods.description: Moves a Discord channel to a new parent or position.

methods.name: setChannelPermissionDiscord
methods.description: Sets permissions for a Discord channel for a specific target.

methods.name: removeChannelPermissionDiscord
methods.description: Removes permissions for a target in a Discord channel.
